platform.title: One platform for the work behind every shift
platform.intro: Bring your workforce, rotas, locations, records, rates, payroll information and client billing together so operations, payroll and finance work from the same current information.
platform.finalText: Book a tailored demonstration using your workforce, locations and billing requirements.

sections.title: Workforce management
sections.text: Keep employee, contractor and subcontractor details, contacts, working records and important documents organised in one profile.

sections.title: Sites and locations
sections.text: Manage business locations, client sites, contacts and default commercial rates without duplicating information.

sections.title: Rotas and shifts
sections.text: Build rotas, assign available team members and organise day, night, weekend and holiday work.

sections.title: Workforce documents
sections.text: Record licences, right-to-work information and document expiry dates, with reminders before action is required.

sections.title: Rates and allowances
sections.text: Apply employee pay rates, client charge rates and allowances to the work they relate to.

sections.title: Payroll preparation
sections.text: Prepare pay information from scheduled or completed assignments, including supported rates and allowances.

sections.title: Client invoicing
sections.text: Prepare client invoices using assignment information, charge rates and approved adjustments.

sections.title: Operational dashboards
sections.text: Review upcoming shifts, workforce status, document warnings and financial information from one dashboard.
